helmet.title: Privacy Policy - Slowork
helmet.description: Privacy Policy for Slowork, connecting remote workers with eco-friendly coworking and coliving spaces.

introduction.title: 1. Introduction
introduction.paragraph1: Slowork (hereinafter referred to as "we," "our," or "the Platform") is a platform designed to connect remote workers, digital nomads, and freelancers with natural environments that foster productivity and well-being. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, share, and protect our users' personal data.
introduction.paragraph2: By using our services, you agree to the practices described in this Privacy Policy. If you do not agree with its terms, please do not use the Platform.

dataController.title: 2. Data Controller
dataController.content: The data controller is Slowork S.L., located at Rodrigo Caro 7, Sevilla, 41004. Contact email: sloworking.adm@gmail.com.

personalData.title: 3. Personal Data We Collect
items: Identification data: Name, surname, email address, date of birth, phone number.
Account data: Username, password, and profile preferences.
Payment data: Billing information and payment methods.
Location data: IP address, geolocation data if enabled.
Interaction data: Booking history, searches, reviews, and comments.
Technical data: IP address, browser type, device, and operating system.
Data from social networks: If you log in via Facebook, Google, LinkedIn, we may receive public profile info and data you authorize us to access.

dataUsage.title: 4. How We Use Your Data
items: Facilitate the creation of user profiles and account management.
Process bookings and transactions.
Personalize the user experience on the Platform.
Send promotional and service communications.
Improve our services and features.
Facilitate communication between users within the Platform.
Comply with legal and regulatory obligations.
Implement security measures and fraud prevention.

legalBasis.title: 5. Legal Basis for Data Processing
items: Contract execution: To provide you with Platform services.
Consent: For sending commercial communications and personalizing services.
Legitimate interest: To improve our Platform and personalize the user experience.
Legal obligations: Compliance with tax and security regulations.

dataSharing.title: 5. Data Sharing and Disclosure
items: With service providers: We may share your data with third-party service providers who assist us in operating the Platform, conducting our business, or servicing you, so long as those parties agree to keep this information confidential.
For legal reasons: We may disclose your information if required to do so by law or in response to valid requests by public authorities (e.g., a court or a government agency).
Business transfers: In the event of a merger, acquisition, or sale of all or a portion of our assets, your personal data may be transferred as part of that transaction.

dataSecurity.title: 6. Data Security
dataSecurity.paragraph1: We implement a variety of security measures to maintain the safety of your personal data when you place an order or enter, submit, or access your personal data.
dataSecurity.paragraph2: These security measures include password protected directories and databases to safeguard your information, and SSL (Secure Socket Layer) technology to ensure that your information is transmitted securely over the internet.

dataRetention.title: 8. Data Retention
dataRetention.paragraph1: We retain personal data for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes described in this Policy and comply with legal obligations.

rows.period: As long as the account is active or up to 5 years after inactivity
10 years (due to tax and accounting regulations)

userRights.title: 7. Your Rights
items: The right to access – You have the right to request copies of your personal data.
The right to rectification – You have the right to request that we correct any information you believe is inaccurate or incomplete.
The right to erasure – You have the right to request that we erase your personal data, under certain conditions.
The right to restrict processing – You have the right to request that we restrict the processing of your personal data, under certain conditions.
The right to data portability – You have the right to request that we transfer the data that we have collected to another organization, or directly to you, under certain conditions.
The right to object to processing – You have the right to object to our processing of your personal data, under certain conditions.

cookiesPolicy.title: 8. Cookies Policy
cookiesPolicy.paragraph1: Like many online services, we use cookies and similar technologies to collect data about your browsing activity and to provide you with a personalized experience.
cookiesPolicy.paragraph2: Cookies are small text files that are used to store small pieces of information. They are stored on your device when the website is loaded on your browser. These cookies help us make the website function properly, make it more secure, provide better user experience, and understand how the website performs and to analyze what works and where it needs improvement.

changesToPolicy.title: 9. Changes to This Privacy Policy
changesToPolicy.paragraph1: We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page.
changesToPolicy.paragraph2: You are advised to review this Privacy Policy periodically for any changes. Changes to this Privacy Policy are effective when they are posted on this page.

contactUs.title: 10. Contact Us
contactUs.paragraph1: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us:
contactUs.paragraph3: By visiting this page on our website: www.slowork.app/contact

helmet.title: Cookies Policy - Slowork
helmet.description: Cookie policy for Slowork, detailing the use of cookies and similar technologies to enhance user experience and ensure the proper functioning of the platform.

introduction.title: 1. Introduction
introduction.paragraph1: At Slowork (hereinafter, "the Platform"), we use cookies and similar technologies to ensure the proper functioning of our website and application, enhance user experience, and provide personalized content tailored to your interests. This Cookie Policy explains what cookies are, how we use them, and how you can manage them.

technologies.title: 2. What Are Cookies and Similar Technologies?
technologies.paragraph1: Cookies are small text files stored on your device (computer, tablet, mobile) when you visit a website. In addition to cookies, we also use similar technologies such as:
items: Web beacons: Small pieces of code embedded in web pages or emails to track user activity.
Local and session storage: Allows information to be stored in your browser to optimize site loading.
Tracking pixels: Used to improve advertising effectiveness.

essential.title: 3.1. Essential (Necessary) Cookies
items: Authentication and user account access.
Session security.
Management of bookings and payments on the Platform.

performance.title: 3.2. Performance and Analytics Cookies
items: Evaluate site traffic and usage.
Measure the performance of different site sections.
Identify technical errors and optimize navigation.

functionality.title: 3.3. Functionality Cookies
items: Selected language.
Display preferences.
Accessibility settings.

marketing.title: 3.4. Advertising and Marketing Cookies
items: Measure the effectiveness of advertising campaigns.
Personalize ads on social media and other websites.

thirdParty.title: 3.5. Third-Party Cookies
items: Interactive maps (Google Maps).
Social media integrations (Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn).
Payment providers (Stripe, PayPal).

duration.title: 4. Duration and Storage of Cookies
items: Session cookies: Automatically deleted when you close your browser.
Persistent cookies: Remain on your device for a specified period or until you delete them.

managing.title: 5. Managing Cookie Preferences
managing.paragraph1: You can manage or delete cookies at any time from your browser settings. Below are some useful links to configure cookies in commonly used browsers:
items: Google Chrome
Mozilla Firefox
Safari
Microsoft Edge
managing.paragraph2: Additionally, if you wish to opt out of receiving personalized advertising cookies, you can visit Your Online Choices.

updates.title: 6. Updates to the Cookie Policy
updates.paragraph1: Slowork may update this Cookie Policy at any time to reflect changes in the use of cookies or applicable regulations, such as the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the Digital Services Act (DSA).
updates.paragraph2: Any significant changes will be communicated to users via the Platform.

contact.title: 7. Contact
contact.paragraph1: If you have any questions about this Cookie Policy, you can contact us at:

helmet.title: Legal Notice - Slowork
helmet.description: Legal notice for Slowork, including terms of use, intellectual property, and user responsibilities.

generalInformation.title: 1. General Information
generalInformation.paragraph1: In accordance with the duty of information established in Article 10 of Law 34/2002, of July 11, on Information Society Services and Electronic Commerce (LSSI-CE), users of this website are informed of the following identifying details:
items: Owner: Slowork S.L
Registered Address: Rodrigo Caro 7, Sevilla, 41004
CIF/NIF: B75950444
Email Address: sloworking.adm@gmail.com
Contact Phone: +34 692390453
Website: www.slowork.app

purposeAndScope.title: 2. Purpose and Scope
purposeAndScope.paragraph1: This Legal Notice governs access, navigation, and use of the Slowork website and platform, which provides a digital tool for searching and booking coliving and coworking spaces for digital nomads and remote workers. Use of this website implies full and unconditional acceptance of all provisions included in this Legal Notice.

users.title: 3.1. Users
users.paragraph1: Access and/or use of this website confers the status of user, implying acceptance of this Legal Notice from the moment of access and/or use.

permittedUse.title: 3.2. Permitted Use
permittedUse.paragraph1: The user agrees to use the website and the services offered in accordance with current legislation, good faith, and public order. The use of the site for unlawful purposes or purposes that may cause harm to Slowork or third parties is prohibited.

registrationAndAuthentication.title: 3.3. Registration and Authentication
registrationAndAuthentication.paragraph1: Some functionalities require registration. The user agrees to provide truthful information and keep their data up to date. Users are responsible for safeguarding their access credentials.

bookingAndCancellation.title: 3.4. Booking and Cancellation Terms
bookingAndCancellation.paragraph1: By using the platform to make reservations, the user accepts the payment, modification, and cancellation terms established in the specific terms and conditions of each offer. Slowork is not responsible for disputes between users and service providers.

intellectualProperty.title: 4. Intellectual and Industrial Property
intellectualProperty.paragraph1: All website content (texts, images, logos, software, structure, and design) is the property of Slowork or authorized third parties, protected by intellectual and industrial property regulations. Reproduction, distribution, or modification without express authorization from the owner is prohibited.

disclaimerOfLiability.title: 5. Disclaimer of Liability
items: Misuse of the website by users.
Continuity of website operation or updates.
The presence of viruses or malicious elements.
Links to third-party websites, which have their own terms and conditions.
Cancellations, refunds, or non-compliance by service providers booked through the platform.

personalDataProtection.title: 6. Personal Data Protection
personalDataProtection.paragraph1: In accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) and Organic Law 3/2018 on Personal Data Protection and Digital Rights Guarantee (LOPDGDD), we inform you that personal data collected through the website will be processed in accordance with our Privacy Policy.
personalDataProtection.paragraph2: Users may exercise their rights of access, rectification, deletion, objection, portability, and restriction of processing by submitting a request to sloworking.adm@gmail.com.

useOfCookies.title: 7. Use of Cookies
useOfCookies.paragraph1: This website uses first- and third-party cookies to enhance user experience and analyze navigation. For more information, see our Cookies Policy. Users can manage their cookie preferences at any time.

applicableLawAndJurisdiction.title: 8. Applicable Law and Jurisdiction
applicableLawAndJurisdiction.paragraph1: For the resolution of any disputes or conflicts related to this website, Spanish legislation will apply, and the parties submit to the Courts and Tribunals of Sevilla, Spain.

disputeResolution.title: 9. Dispute Resolution
disputeResolution.paragraph1: In the event of a dispute, users may opt for alternative dispute resolution mechanisms, such as mediation or arbitration, before resorting to legal action.

helmet.title: Terms and Conditions of Use - Slowork
helmet.description: Terms and conditions of use for Slowork: waitlist, creator program, credits, content license, acceptable use and data protection.

blocks.text: This document governs the terms and conditions of use (hereinafter, the "T&C") applicable to access, browsing and use of the website www.slowork.app (hereinafter, the "Platform"), owned by SLOWORK, S.L. (hereinafter, "SLOWORK"), with Tax ID No. B75950444 and registered office at Calle Rodrigo Caro, 7, 1º Izquierda, 41004 – Seville (Spain).
For the purposes of these T&C, "User" means any person who accesses, browses, registers, submits information or participates in any of the Platform's features.

Access to, browsing of, registration on or use of the Platform implies that the User has read, understood and expressly accepted these T&C, as well as, where applicable, the <1>Privacy Policy</1> and the Cookie Policy.
For the purposes of these T&C, the following terms shall mean:

items.text: the website, forms, pages, digital spaces, tools, private areas, dashboards, internal portals or any digital functionalities enabled by SLOWORK.
the waiting list to receive information about the launch of SLOWORK, future functionalities, campaigns, early access or project updates.
the promotional and community pre-launch dynamic enabled by SLOWORK to encourage the creation of organic content aligned with SLOWORK's brand identity and narrative.
any text, image, video, audio, publication, reel, short, story, carousel, post, link, creative piece or material uploaded, published, submitted or linked by the User to SLOWORK.
internal, non-monetary promotional units that SLOWORK may assign to certain Users within the creator program according to its internal rules and these T&C.

blocks.text: In the current development phase, SLOWORK makes available to the User a Platform primarily intended to:

items: a) allow registration in the Waitlist or waiting list to receive communications about the future launch of the platform and its services;
b) enable forms, promotional campaigns and community dynamics;
c) manage a pre-launch creator program, based on the creation and validation of organic content aligned with SLOWORK's identity, narrative and lifestyle; and
d) provide general information about the brand, community, vision, product or upcoming services.

blocks.text: Unless SLOWORK publishes additional specific terms, no paid service is currently provided to the User, no booking is formalized, and no accommodation, coworking, coliving or tourist service contract is concluded through the Platform.
If in the future SLOWORK enables paid services, bookings, online contracting or transactional functionalities, such operations shall be subject to new specific terms or an update of these T&C.
The User declares that they have sufficient legal capacity to be bound by these T&C.
Those who do not have sufficient legal capacity to do so, or who do so in breach of applicable law, may not use the Platform.
General access to the Platform is free of charge, without prejudice to the costs of Internet connection, data or devices borne by the User.
SLOWORK may deny, limit, suspend or cancel access to the Platform when it deems that use is contrary to law, these T&C, good faith or the purpose of the service.

Registration in the Waitlist is voluntary and allows the User to express their interest in receiving information about the launch of SLOWORK, project updates, early access, calls, campaigns or future functionalities.
Registration in the Waitlist:

items: a) does not guarantee definitive access to the platform;
b) does not grant an automatic right to a spot, contracting, booking or admission to specific programs;
c) does not entail the conclusion of a service provision contract; and
d) may be subject to internal validation, segmentation, quota or launch strategy criteria.

blocks.text: The User must provide truthful, accurate, complete and up-to-date data. SLOWORK may request, among others, name, email address, nationality, interests, motivation or any other information reasonably linked to the informational, statistical purpose, community validation or launch preparation.
Providing false, outdated, incomplete or third-party data without sufficient legal basis may result in exclusion from the Waitlist or suspension of the corresponding participation.

The User may request at any time to unsubscribe from the Waitlist and deletion of their data, under the terms provided in the Privacy Policy and through the contact channels enabled by SLOWORK, including the email slowork@slowork.app.
SLOWORK may enable a creator program aimed at encouraging the creation of high-quality organic content around SLOWORK's lifestyle, values, community and narrative.

This program is promotional, community-based and brand-focused in nature. Unless SLOWORK expressly indicates otherwise in writing, it is not conceived as an employment relationship, a paid professional activity, a classic affiliate network, a commercial agency, a brand representation with power to bind, nor a guaranteed income opportunity.

The purpose of the program is to reinforce brand awareness, build community, validate messages and recognize certain contributions through credits or internal promotional rewards, in accordance with the rules published by SLOWORK at any given time.
Participation in the program will be voluntary and may require:

items: a) prior registration or sign-up on the Platform;
b) express acceptance of these T&C;
c) provision of profile data or social networks;
d) compliance with brand or campaign instructions; and
e) validation by SLOWORK.

blocks.text: SLOWORK may accept, reject, pause or cancel the participation of any User when it reasonably considers it necessary for reasons of quality, reputation, fraud, security, regulatory compliance or brand protection.
Unless otherwise communicated by SLOWORK, content published within the creator program may be disseminated, during the pre-launch phase, on channels such as:

items: a) Instagram;
b) TikTok;
c) YouTube.

blocks.text: SLOWORK may expand, limit or replace these channels at any time.

Content may be subject to a pre-validation system prior to its publication on social media. The User may upload to the Platform material in "draft" or "preview" status for prior review by SLOWORK. SLOWORK may approve the draft, but final approval and credit assignment shall be conditional upon subsequent publication of the content on the accepted channels and effective verification of its proper publication and tagging according to collaboration instructions.
Approval of content in draft status does not generate an acquired right to credits until its effective publication and review in accordance with the ordinary procedure.
This double validation policy will be duly informed and explained in the user area and in the program's informational materials.
In the event of disagreements regarding the validity of the content or its publication, the user will have access to the internal complaints management system, which is set out in section 6.15.
The program may operate in two distinct states: a) Pre-publication: submission and review of a draft; b) Post-publication: verification of effective publication and compliance with instructions.
The flow will include the states:

states: PENDING_REVIEW (content published, in final review queue)
REJECTED (rejected, with right to appeal under 6.15)

blocks.text: SLOWORK may review each piece according to brand, quality, authenticity and narrative usefulness criteria, including, among others:

items: a) existence of a correct mention of SLOWORK;
b) sufficient visual, audio and technical quality;
c) alignment with SLOWORK's identity, tone and lifestyle;
d) absence of aggressive promotion or misleading messages;
e) originality and absence of duplicated, recycled or spam content;
f) narrative value, inspiration, connection or authenticity;
g) compliance with the law, these T&C and the rules of the social network used.

blocks.text: SLOWORK may use checklists, internal scoring, bonuses, assigned reviewers or any other evaluation system. Such mechanisms are internal management tools and may be modified at any time. The criteria and their application will be available to users and will be explained in the documentation accessible on the Platform.
Content will not be valid, among other cases, if it:

items: a) lacks sufficient mention of SLOWORK;
b) is of low technical quality or manifestly low effort;
c) is not aligned with the brand or its narrative;
d) has an aggressive, misleading or brand-inappropriate promotional tone;
e) consists of spam, unauthorized giveaways, empty or generic content;
f) is duplicated, recycled, automated or not original;
g) uses artificial metrics, bots, engagement purchases or manipulation;
h) uses language presenting the program as a money system, easy income or an economic promise;
i) violates third-party rights, social platform rules or applicable law.

blocks.text: The user may challenge the decision through the system detailed in section 6.9.

SLOWORK may establish operational limits and anti-fraud controls to protect the integrity of the creator program, the reliability of the credit system, the security of the Platform and the experience of other users, including, among others, the following: (i) maximum submission limits per day and/or per period; (ii) validation of unique links and URL verification; (iii) detection of reposts, duplicates, recycled content or spam; (iv) detection of multiple accounts associated with the same person, device, usage pattern or reasonable linkage indicators; (v) manual or enhanced verification of the permanence of approved content for the minimum required period; and (vi) enhanced review of metrics or anomalous interactions, including indications of manipulation, bots, engagement purchases or non-organic patterns.

For these purposes, SLOWORK may apply proportionate technical and organizational measures, which may include: requests for additional information to verify authorship or authenticity of content; requests for screenshots, alternative links or reasonable evidence; temporary limitation of new uploads; placement in an enhanced review queue; preventive blocking of credit accrual until verification is completed; cancellation or reversal of credits improperly obtained; and, in serious or repeated cases, temporary suspension or cancellation of the User's access to the program or to certain Platform functionalities, in accordance with these T&C.

SLOWORK will maintain a specific policy against improper uses, under which it may, for a reasonable period and after prior warning when appropriate, suspend or limit access to the Platform or the program for (i) Users who frequently provide manifestly unlawful content, or (ii) Users who frequently submit manifestly unfounded notices or complaints through the enabled mechanisms, when such conduct affects operations, security or system integrity. This policy will be applied diligently and objectively, case by case, taking into account all relevant circumstances.

When deciding on the application of measures for improper uses, SLOWORK will assess, at least: (i) absolute numbers of problematic submissions or actions in a period; (ii) relative proportion compared to the User's total submissions; (iii) seriousness and potential impact (including fraud, impersonation, infringement of third-party rights or reputational impact); and (iv) when reasonably determinable, intent. SLOWORK will endeavor, where appropriate, to issue prior warnings before ordering suspensions, except in cases of seriousness, risk, urgency or need to protect the Platform, third parties or the brand.

Measures may be graduated, for guidance, among: (i) submission limitation (for example, temporary reduction of the daily maximum); (ii) temporary suspension of the ability to upload content or request review; (iii) temporary suspension of access to the creator program; and (iv) permanent cancellation of access to the program in serious or repeated cases. The duration of suspensions will be reasonable and proportional to the type of breach and its recurrence; as a general rule, depending on severity, it may range between 9 days and 12 months, without prejudice to SLOWORK adopting more restrictive measures when essential due to fraud, impersonation, infringement of third-party rights or significant legal or reputational risk.
Application of these measures shall not prevent the User from filing an appeal or complaint through the internal system described in the following provision.

subsections.title: 6.9. Internal complaint management system for moderation, validation and suspension decisions

blocks.text: SLOWORK provides Users with an agile and effective internal complaint management system to appeal decisions adopted within the moderation and management of the program and/or the Platform, including, among others: (i) decisions to remove, disable or block access to content; (ii) rejection of content in pre-validation or final validation; (iii) blocking, reversal or non-assignment of credits for reasons linked to verification, fraud or breach; and (iv) suspension, limitation or cancellation of accounts or access to the creator program.

The User must submit their complaint by email to slowork@slowork.app, clearly indicating: (i) their identification and, where applicable, username/handle on the Platform; (ii) the affected piece or decision (including content ID if any, link/URL and approximate date); (iii) the reason for the appeal, with a specific explanation of the facts; and (iv) available supporting documentation, including screenshots, links, relevant metrics and any other reasonable evidence allowing SLOWORK to review the case.

Complaints will be processed and resolved by SLOWORK staff through human review, and the final decision will not depend exclusively on automated means. The maximum indicative timeframe to resolve and communicate the decision will be 10 business days from full receipt of the complaint (i.e., from when the User has provided the minimum information necessary for processing). The response will include sufficient reasoning for the outcome and SLOWORK will keep internal records of the complaint and the decision adopted.

During processing of the complaint, when the dispute concerns the removal or disabling of access to content uploaded by the User, such content will not remain accessible to the general public on the Platform while the internal procedure is resolved. The foregoing is without prejudice to the User keeping the content on their social networks or external channels, if compatible with the appealed decision and with the program rules.

The internal complaint system will be made available to the User in a simple and transparent manner, and SLOWORK will inform in its T&C and/or in the corresponding area of the Platform about the criteria, time limits and available appeal channels, including, where appropriate, the possibility of providing additional information during processing.
SLOWORK will progressively implement the following measures to protect minors and the general public in accordance with Spanish and European audiovisual regulations:

items: Easy-to-use systems for users to report unlawful or potentially harmful content.
Explanation to users of the course of action taken in response to received notifications.
Age verification and parental control regarding content that may harm the physical, mental or moral development of minors.
Media literacy measures and information on good practices for use of the Platform.

Alternative dispute resolution procedure for consumers, in accordance with the provisions of Law 7/2017 and the General Law for the Defense of Consumers and Users. These measures will be detailed in the corresponding area of the Platform and will be informed clearly and accessibly.

blocks.text: When SLOWORK enables it, the User may receive internal promotional credits for approved content.
Credits:

items: a) do not constitute money, salary, cash commission, labor remuneration or a financial instrument;
b) are promotional and internal in nature;
c) may only be used within the SLOWORK ecosystem, in the manner SLOWORK enables at any time;
d) are not refundable, transferable or exchangeable for cash;
e) do not generate an indefinite acquired right; and
f) may be subject to limits, expiration dates, usage rules and additional validations.

blocks.text: The internal equivalence of the credit that SLOWORK may use for promotional, operational or system purposes does not alter its non-monetary nature.
Unless subsequently modified by SLOWORK, the base credit allocation in the current phase may follow the following logic:
SLOWORK may grant additional bonuses when content reaches certain performance or verifiable impact thresholds.
As guidance, bonuses may be contemplated for:

items: a) high engagement or high views;
b) relevant volume of qualified interactions;
c) especially outstanding narrative or brand impact;
d) exceptional quality or strategic affinity with the campaign.

blocks.text: Bonus assignment will always be discretionary and will require validation by SLOWORK.

subsections.title: 6.14. Accrual, validity and use of credits

blocks.text: Credits shall only be deemed accrued when the content has been expressly approved by SLOWORK.
Unless SLOWORK indicates otherwise:

items: a) credits will be valid for 365 days from assignment;
b) their use may be limited to a maximum of 50% of the value of each transaction or enabled redemption;
c) they may only be used when SLOWORK activates specific functionalities allowing their application; and
d) mere accumulation of credits does not oblige SLOWORK to launch any service, functionality or redemption system on a specific date.

subsections.title: 6.15. Withdrawal, reversal or loss of credits

blocks.text: SLOWORK may withdraw, block, cancel or reverse credits already assigned when:

items: a) it detects fraud, manipulation or breach;
b) approved content is deleted, hidden or substantially altered before the minimum period required by SLOWORK;
c) it is verified that metrics, interactions or publications were not authentic;
d) the content infringes these T&C or third-party rights; or
e) a material assignment error occurs.

blocks.text: In particular, if the User removes validated content before 3 months have elapsed since its approval, SLOWORK may withdraw the credits associated with that piece.
If the User has already used those credits, SLOWORK may offset them with future credits, temporarily suspend access to the program, or apply the internal regularization that corresponds.

subsections.title: 6.16. No employment, paid commercial relationship or representation

blocks.text: Participation in the creator program does not create an employment relationship, paid commercial relationship, agency, representation, mandate, partnership, joint venture or exclusivity link between the User and SLOWORK.
The User may not act on behalf of SLOWORK or assume commitments, statements, promises or binding declarations on behalf of SLOWORK without prior and express written authorization.

sections.title: 7. License over content, UGC, image and promotional uses

blocks.text: The User warrants that they have all rights, permissions, consents and authorizations necessary over the content they publish, upload, submit, link or associate with SLOWORK within the Platform, the creator program or any campaign linked to the brand.
In particular, the User warrants that:

items: a) the content is original or has sufficient rights for its use;
b) its publication and reuse by SLOWORK does not infringe intellectual property, industrial property, image rights, honor, privacy, data protection or any other third-party rights;
c) any identifiable person appearing in the content has provided, where required, the necessary consent for the capture and use of their image, voice or name;

d) music, audios, clips, templates, effects, visual resources, brands, locations or any other elements incorporated into the content allow their promotional and advertising use by SLOWORK under the terms provided herein; and
e) the content is not subject to restrictions incompatible with its commercial and advertising use by SLOWORK.

blocks.text: The User will be liable to SLOWORK and to third parties for any claim arising from a lack of sufficient rights or authorizations over the content provided.

subsections.title: 7.2. License to use content and UGC

blocks.text: By participating in the Waitlist, campaigns, community dynamics or the creator program, the User grants SLOWORK a non-exclusive, free, worldwide, sublicensable license, for all types of media, supports, channels and formats, online and offline, over the content submitted, published or linked to SLOWORK, to:

b) publicly communicate, disseminate, redistribute and republish it;
c) transform, adapt, edit, crop, subtitle, translate, reframe, resize, lay out, combine it with other materials or adjust it to different formats and channels;
d) incorporate it into creative pieces, landings, newsletters, decks, editorial materials, commercial materials, presentations, internal supports or brand campaigns; and

e) use it as UGC (user generated content) in communication, awareness, performance, remarketing, acquisition, social validation, community, press, events, commercial presentations or product promotion actions.

blocks.text: This license covers both organic uses and promoted or paid uses, including its use in ads and advertising campaigns disseminated by SLOWORK on its own channels or through third-party platforms.

The above license expressly includes SLOWORK's ability to use the User's content in digital advertising or paid media campaigns, including, among others, campaigns on Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, Google and equivalent paid social, paid video, display, remarketing or performance formats.

SLOWORK may use the content as a primary or secondary advertising creative, testimonial, social proof, remarketing piece, audiovisual cut, carousel, short-form video, landing asset, email asset or any other promotional format reasonably linked to the brand.

subsections.title: 7.4. Authorization over image, voice, name and public profile

blocks.text: The User expressly authorizes SLOWORK, to the extent necessary for the purposes described, to use their name or alias, username or public identifier on social networks, image, voice, profile photo, likeness, appearance and other identifying elements that appear in the content, for the purposes of validation, dissemination, communication, branding, awareness, community and advertising of SLOWORK.

This authorization includes the possibility of mentioning the User as a creator, collaborator or member of the SLOWORK community, provided that this is not misleading or implies attributing to them functions or legal relationships that do not actually exist.

The above license and authorization are granted for the maximum term permitted by law for the corresponding purpose or, failing that, while the content is useful for archival, evidentiary, campaign history, community, communication or reasonable promotional exploitation purposes of SLOWORK.
However, the User may request removal of the content for future uses not yet executed or committed, without affecting:

items: a) campaigns already active, launched, approved or budgeted;
b) materials already produced, edited or distributed;
c) publications already made;
d) internal evidence, archives, backups, logs or supports necessary for evidentiary, legal, accounting, anti-fraud or compliance purposes.

blocks.text: SLOWORK may technically adapt the content for its campaigns and channels, but undertakes not to use it in a manifestly demeaning, denigrating or out-of-context manner that illegitimately harms the User's reputation.

helmet.title: Slowork Impact Program
helmet.description: Empowering sustainable remote work communities worldwide. Get your space remote-work ready and make a difference. The Slowork Impact Program is designed to support digital nomads, remote workers, and eco-conscious travelers by improving access to high-quality coworking and coliving spaces in underserved or rural areas.

hero.title: IMPACT PROGRAM
hero.subtitle: We believe there's more to life than just working to live.

story.title: Our Story
story.paragraph1: Slowork was born from a simple yet powerful realization: we have an incredible planet that deserves to be protected and enjoyed. We created Slowork for people like you, who dream of working from anywhere, connecting deeply with nature, living with intention, and sharing meaningful moments with others along the way.
story.paragraph2: We're not just a platform; we're a global movement of remote workers, digital nomads, freelancers, entrepreneurs, and conscious companies who want to redefine what it means to be productive.

mission.title: Our mission is clear
mission.paragraph1: We want to help you break free from crowded cities, stressful routines, and uninspiring offices. Slowork connects you to unique coliving and coworking spaces in breathtaking natural settings, places that combine fast internet, peaceful work environments, and activities that nourish your body, mind, and spirit.
mission.paragraph2: But it's much more than that. We're building a real community of people who value authentic human connection. Here, you can share experiences, learn from others, collaborate on projects, and grow alongside like-minded souls.
mission.paragraph3: But purpose goes beyond lifestyle. With the Slowork Impact Program, we reinvest part of every reservation into local communities helping eco-conscious hosts improve their spaces and opening the door for sustainable growth in underrepresented regions.

howItWorks.title: How it works
items: Up to 2% of each transaction goes directly to the Impact Program:
1% chosen by our community: After every booking, users vote on a project to support.
1% allocated by Slowork: Based on local needs and development potential.
All projects are listed on the Slowork Impact Funding Portal, open for donations.
Funds are delivered via Stripe (bank transfer) or Bitcoin (P2P).
Hosts receive advisory support to meet our certification standards.
Hosts must submit proof of improvements via photos, reports, and audits.

whatWeSupport.title: What we support
whatWeSupport.subtitle: We back projects that improve:
items: Internet connectivity
Hygiene and basic services
Coliving/coworking conditions
Eco-practices and community inclusion
Local business training and hospitality development

whyItMatters.title: Why it matters
whyItMatters.paragraph: We're building a network where remote work uplifts local life, not replaces it. By staying in a Slowork space, you help us support rural hosts, protect cultural heritage, and make work-from-anywhere more inclusive, fair, and sustainable.

cta.title: Join the Change
cta.subtitle: Ready to become part of the change? Join Slowork and make impact part of your journey.
